arm.allocator: evidence_niches: a centre earns its niche by being far AND carrying evidence (parameter-free, degrades to max-min when utility is flat); escape drains; jump floor removed; parent tilt expressed as a ratio in measured-reward units so evidence terms are not swamped by a dimensionless base of 1.0
arm.name: A_baseline_1k
arm.what_differs: ONLY this flag. Same initialization, executor, chemistry, budget, seed and allocator repair in both arms. Arm A leaves online_memory None, so the adapter delegates to the unmodified production _channel_proposal and the region law is None -- the only true no-op, since an unlawed draw consumes rng.permutation while any law object consumes rng.random.

revision_boundary.stored_state_restored_exactly: round-trip tested; a dropped component breaks the round trip
revision_boundary.what_changed: state persistence and resume accounting ONLY: OnlineProposalMemory gained payload/restore_payload so a resumed arm cannot silently restart cold; the query ledger permits an authorized budget INCREASE (never a decrease, task still immutable); the worker gained an extension path distinct from retry and backfill.
revision_boundary.what_did_NOT_change: proposal semantics. No region law, weighting, family choice, parent selection, credit rule or executor behaviour was touched, so the proposals that produced calls 1-250 would be produced identically by this revision.
